name: Cyprus: self-employed

tests: More than 183 days in the year, or the 60-day rule (60 days, a business or job in Cyprus, a home there, no other tax residence)

regimes.name: Non-domiciled
regimes.summary: Exempt from the special defence contribution on dividends and interest for 17 years; business income is still taxed

regimes.name: Crypto gains
regimes.summary: Gains on crypto-assets taxed at 8% from 2026

source.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Cyprus, residence

calendar.note: VAT returns and payment are due by the 10th day of the second month after each quarter. From tax year 2026 the self-employed who prepare accounts file and pay by 31 January of the second following year, with provisional tax on 31 July and 31 December.

workdays.note: Not verified whether deadlines here move off weekends and holidays. Kyros shows the last working day on or before the legal date, so paying on it is always in time, and keeps the reserve locked until the next working day after it.
